died.name: Patrick Henry
died.last_words: Doctor, I wish you to observe how real and beneficial the religion of Christ is to a man about to die.... I am, however, much consoled by reflecting that the religion of Christ has, from its first appearance in the world, been attacked in vain by all the wits, philosophers, and wise ones, aided by every power of man, and its triumphs have been complete.

died.name: Jeremy Bentham
died.desc: English philosopher, jurist and social reformer
died.last_words: I now feel that I am dying. Our care must be to minimize the pain. Do not let any of the servants come into the room, and keep away the youths. It will be distressing to them, and they can be of no service. Yet I must not be alone, and you will remain with me, and you only, and then we shall have reduced the pain to the least possible amount.

died.name: Camillo Benso, Count of Cavour
died.desc: Italian statesman, Prime Minister of Italy
died.cause: to Victor Emmanuel II of Italy, who had said he would see him tomorrow
died.last_words: No, Your Majesty, to-morrow you will not see me here.

died.name: Turner Ashby
died.desc: Confederate cavalry commander of the American Civil War
died.cause: before being killed at Harrisonburg, Virginia
died.last_words: Charge Men! For God's sake charge!

died.name: Archduchess Mathilda of Austria
died.cause: The 18-year-old daughter of Archduke Albrecht, Duke of Teschen set her dress on fire while trying to hide a cigarette from her father, who had forbidden her to smoke.

died.name: Carl Jung
died.last_words: Let's have a really good red wine tonight.

died.name: Robert F. Kennedy
died.cause: speaking to medical attendants who lifted him onto a stretcher several minutes after he was fatally shot and lost consciousness shortly thereafter

died.name: Huguette Gaulin
died.cause: who committed suicide by burning herself
died.last_words: You have destroyed the beauty of the world!

died.name: Feltus Taylor
died.last_words: I want to tell you, Keith, and the Ponsano family that I always regretted what I've done. It was my own doing. After this is over with, I hope you can find the peace to move on.

born.name: Hortense Mancini
born.desc: Duchesse de Mazarin, niece of Cardinal Mazarin and mistress of Charles II of England

born.name: Nathan Hale
born.cause: before being hanged by the British for his involvement in the American Revolutionary War
born.last_words: I only regret that I have but one life to give for my country.

born.name: Robert Falcon Scott
born.desc: Royal Navy officer and Antarctic explorer
born.cause: final diary entry on doomed Terra Nova Expedition
born.last_words: Last Entry - For God's sake look after our people

born.name: Italo Balbo
born.cause: The 44-year-old governor of Italian Libya and marshal of the Regia Aeronautica was flying his personal Savoia-Marchetti SM.79 when the Libyan airfield at Tobruk was attacked by a squad of British planes. He was killed by friendly fire from Italian anti-aircraft batteries on the ground.

born.name: Jack Youll
born.cause: prior to being killed in action at the Battle of Vittorio Veneto during World War I
born.last_words: It's all right Cowling; we've got them stone cold.

born.name: Isaiah Berlin
born.last_words: And where do you come from?

born.name: Neville Heath
born.cause: when he was offered a drink prior to his execution by hanging
born.last_words: You might make that a double.
